messages.text: Map the chain from a AI market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Oscilloscope.

### Chain mapping
| AI market requirement | Measurable parameter / test item | Required Oscilloscope capability supported by passages | Evidence / gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| AI data center infrastructure emphasizes **Connectivity** as a core capability, and the data-center connectivity portfolio includes high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection. [15][62] | High-speed interface / signal-integrity validation can include **Eye diagram**, plus IL / Xtalk and TDR impedance in the SI flow. [65] | The oscilloscope requirement supported by the passages is **Interface Test using scopes**; the passages do not specify oscilloscope bandwidth, sample rate, model, software option, or pass/fail limits. [65][4][5] | Supported chain: **Connectivity → Eye diagram / interface validation → oscilloscope used for Interface Test**, with detailed scope capability unspecified. [15][65][4][5] |
| AI server PCB trends are described as pushing PCB toward high layer count, large area, and **high-speed transmission**. [75] | The SI/PI overview lists **IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram** and **TDR Impedance** as high-speed PCB / PCBA signal-integrity flow items. [65] | The passages support oscilloscope involvement only at the level of **scopes for Interface Test**; they do not state a formal oscilloscope configuration for 112G / 224G / 448G AI interconnect validation. [65][66] | Supported chain: **AI server high-speed transmission → Eye diagram / SI validation → scope-based Interface Test**, but exact oscilloscope capability is not given. [75][65][66] |
| AI data center infrastructure also emphasizes **Power** as a core capability. [15] | The SI/PI overview maps **Power Distribution Network** testing to scopes and network analyzers, and the R&S AI server mapping lists **Power rail**, **multiphase DC**, and **PI** under MXO. [65][72] | The oscilloscope capability supported by the passages is **power rail / multiphase DC / PI measurement with MXO**; PDN Target Z is separately mapped to R&S ZNL, not to the oscilloscope. [72] | Supported chain: **Power → PDN / power rail / multiphase DC / PI → MXO oscilloscope power-analysis role**, with option, fixture, and calibration details not provided. [65][72][69] |
### Minimal conclusion
【推論】The clearest oscilloscope chain in the passages is **AI Connectivity / high-speed transmission → Eye diagram or interface validation → oscilloscope used for Interface Test**, but the required oscilloscope bandwidth, data rate coverage, probes, and compliance software are not specified. [15][75][65][4][5]  
【推論】For AI power requirements, the supported oscilloscope chain is **Power → PDN / power rail / multiphase DC / PI → MXO power-analysis role**, while formal options and test setup remain unspecified. [15][65][72][69]

- [[Data center server 高速互連產品組合]] 偏向 data center server interconnect portfolio 的分類表；[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 更強調 full-spectrum：electrical interconnect + optical + fiber + power + cooling。
- [[Compute tray component solutions]] 偏向 compute tray connectors、cables、power connector、busbar 與 backplane interconnect；本頁納入 optical transceiver、CPO、fiber deployment 與 liquid cooling。
- [[高速伺服器儲存互連]] 可連接本頁中的 [[Mini Cool Edge IO]]、[[Cool Express Link]]、[[Direct Attached Copper Cables]]、[[PCIe CEM 7 Connectors]] 與 storage / EDSFF 類產品。
- [[CPO]]、[[Optical I-O]]、[[Near-Packaged Optics]] 可連接本頁的 [[Amphenol Co-packaged Optics]] 與 [[LEAP On-Board Transceiver]]，但本來源不是技術標準或市場採用證據。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › High-speed electrical connectivity
- [[Amphenol OverPass Cable Systems]] — 來源稱其 enable high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to end-points across the system。
- [[ExtremePort OSFP Connectors]] — 來源稱 connectors and cages have 60 contacts per port、0.6 mm pitch，並 optimized for signal integrity、thermal management and multi-lane pluggable architecture。
- [[Amphenol XtremePass]] — 來源稱 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP，並跨 Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems。
- [[OSFP Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱 OSFP cable assemblies compatible with 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4，deliver aggregate bandwidths of 200G、400G、800G and 1.6T per cable assembly，available in Passive and Active variants。
- [[Sentry HD High-Speed Backplane Connector]] — 來源稱其是 next-generation high-speed backplane connector platform。
- [[Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors]] — 來源稱其 designed to support data rates up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。

### Chain mapping
| AI market requirement | Measurable parameter / test item | Required Oscilloscope capability supported by passages | Evidence / gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| AI data center infrastructure emphasizes **Connectivity** as a core capability, and the data-center connectivity portfolio includes high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection. [15][62] | High-speed interface / signal-integrity validation can include **Eye diagram**, plus IL / Xtalk and TDR impedance in the SI flow. [65] | The oscilloscope requirement supported by the passages is **Interface Test using scopes**; the passages do not specify oscilloscope bandwidth, sample rate, model, software option, or pass/fail limits. [65][4][5] | Supported chain: **Connectivity → Eye diagram / interface validation → oscilloscope used for Interface Test**, with detailed scope capability unspecified. [15][65][4][5] |
| AI server PCB trends are described as pushing PCB toward high layer count, large area, and **high-speed transmission**. [75] | The SI/PI overview lists **IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram** and **TDR Impedance** as high-speed PCB / PCBA signal-integrity flow items. [65] | The passages support oscilloscope involvement only at the level of **scopes for Interface Test**; they do not state a formal oscilloscope configuration for 112G / 224G / 448G AI interconnect validation. [65][66] | Supported chain: **AI server high-speed transmission → Eye diagram / SI validation → scope-based Interface Test**, but exact oscilloscope capability is not given. [75][65][66] |
| AI data center infrastructure also emphasizes **Power** as a core capability. [15] | The SI/PI overview maps **Power Distribution Network** testing to scopes and network analyzers, and the R&S AI server mapping lists **Power rail**, **multiphase DC**, and **PI** under MXO. [65][72] | The oscilloscope capability supported by the passages is **power rail / multiphase DC / PI measurement with MXO**; PDN Target Z is separately mapped to R&S ZNL, not to the oscilloscope. [72] | Supported chain: **Power → PDN / power rail / multiphase DC / PI → MXO oscilloscope power-analysis role**, with option, fixture, and calibration details not provided. [65][72][69] |
### Minimal conclusion
【推論】The clearest oscilloscope chain in the passages is **AI Connectivity / high-speed transmission → Eye diagram or interface validation → oscilloscope used for Interface Test**, but the required oscilloscope bandwidth, data rate coverage, probes, and compliance software are not specified. [15][75][65][4][5]  
【推論】For AI power requirements, the supported oscilloscope chain is **Power → PDN / power rail / multiphase DC / PI → MXO power-analysis role**, while formal options and test setup remain unspecified. [15][65][72][69]

- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）標題為「PCB供應鏈升級重點」。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 AI伺服器趨勢推升 [[PCB]] 邁向高層數、大面積與高速傳輸，供應鏈全面翻新。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 [[AWS Trainium 2 Max]]、[[Google TPU V6]]、[[Meta MTIA 2]] 量產，並稱 2026年新平台將陸續推出。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 [[HVLP銅箔]] 進入第4、5代，[[CCL]] 以 [[M8]] 為主，導入低介電、低損耗與高散熱設計。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱主板層數達 30～40 層，縱深比需達 12～14 倍，並需應對厚銅、雷射鑽孔等高階製程。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 TPCA Show 焦點聚焦玻纖布、HVLP銅箔、CCL 發展與高縱深比設備，反映材料與製程全面升級。
- [[HSD PCB image 1]]（來源發布日期未標示；取得於 2026-09-04）以「GB200/GB300/VR200規格：南亞和臻鼎為亮點」為標題，比較 [[GB200]] NVL72(72GPU)、[[GB300]] NVL72(72GPU) 與 [[VR200]] NVL144(72GPU) 的時間、製程、功耗、載板、CCL 材料、上游材料、ComputeTray、NVSwitch Tray、CPX 與 Midplane。
- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）與 [[HSD PCB image 1]] 高度重疊，同樣以「GB200/GB300/VR200規格：南亞和臻鼎為亮點」為標題，右上角標示「資料來源：產業調研、福邦投顧整理」。

- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）列出 [[GB300]] 使用 **HVLP3銅箔**，[[VR200]] 使用 **HVLP4銅箔**，並將 [[VR200]] 交換板 CCL 材料列為 **M8(LDK2+HVLP4) 生益科技/台光電/南亞(交期最快)**。
- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）列出 [[VR200]] ComputeTray PCB 供應商 / 占比為 **欣興35~40% > 臻鼎25~30% = 勝宏25~30%**。
